objective.text: Apply a per-parent eager-loading limit on a supported database rather than treating it as a global child cap.

difficulty.rationale: Interpret a relationship limit in the current framework instead of assuming one global result cap.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: Laravel 13.40; SQLite with window-function support. No global scopes.

stem: Writer 1 has articles 1 and 2; writer 2 has article 3. How many articles are loaded for each writer?
